hero.heading: Sanātana Dharma
hero.description: A timeless spiritual tradition rooted in darma, karma, and self-realization, guiding humanity beyond time, culture, and belief.

sections.content: Learn the essence of Sanātana Dharma - an external, universal truth and way of life that transcends the cycles of time and culture.

sections.title: A Living Spiritual Tradition
sections.content: A living spiritual tradition is a dynamic, evolving practice that preserves ancient wisdom while adapting to contemporary life, nurturing faith, culture, ethics, and collective identity.

sections.title: Core Principles of Sanātana Dharma
sections.content: Sanātana Dharma upholds eternal truth, dharma, non‑violence, compassion, self‑realization, devotion, harmony, respect for all beings, and unity with the divine through righteous living.

sections.title: Commitment to Authenticity
sections.content: Commitment to authenticity means living truthfully, honoring values, expressing genuine identity, rejecting falsehood, fostering integrity, and embodying transparency in relationships, actions, and spiritual practice.

sections.title: Why Sanātana Dharma Matters Today
sections.content: Sanātana Dharma matters today because it offers timeless wisdom, ethical guidance, spiritual harmony, universal compassion, and resilience, fostering peace, unity, and balance in modern life.
points: Mental clarity in a fast-paced world

sections.title: Purpose of Sanātana Dharma
sections.content: The purpose of Sanātana Dharma is to guide humanity toward truth, harmony, self‑realization, righteous living, compassion, and liberation, sustaining universal balance and eternal wisdom.

sections.title: What You Will Find Here
sections.content: What you will find here is timeless wisdom, spiritual guidance, cultural heritage, ethical principles, inspiring stories, and practices nurturing harmony, devotion, truth, and liberation.
points: Concept clarity on Karma and Dharma

sections.title: A Timeless Journey
sections.content: A timeless journey is an eternal path of wisdom, growth, devotion, discovery, and liberation, transcending ages while guiding souls toward truth, harmony, and divine unity.

home.ourfourcoreyugassubtitle: The eternal and universal way of life based on truth, righteousness, and spiritual principles that uphold cosmic order. These numbers are not random. They are derived from a base unit of 432,000, multiplied proportionally (4: 3: 2: 1). One Full Day of Brahma: Lifetime of Brahma - 100 Brahma years - Each year = 360 days - Each day = 4 yugas (ages) - Total = 311,040,000,000 human years.

heading: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे
सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्
मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्॥
shivastotram.transliteration: Oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭi-vardhanam | Urvarukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt ||

heading: शान्ताकारम् भुजगशयनम् पद्मनाभम् सुरेशम्।
विश्वाधारम् गगनसदृशम् मेघवर्णम् शुभाङ्गम्।
लक्ष्मीकान्तम् कमलनयनम् योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यम्।
वन्दे विष्णुम् भवभयहरम् सर्वलोकैकनाथम्॥
krishnastotram.transliteration: I bow to Vishnu—Who has a peaceful demeanor (Shanta-karam)...

title: यदा यदा हि
धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानम धर्मस्य
तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
krishnastotram2.transliteration: Yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata, Abhyutthāna madharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmyaham.
krishnastotram2.translation: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in righteousness (Dharma), O descendant of Bharata (Arjuna), and a predominance of unrighteousness (Adharma)—at that time I manifest Myself (take birth).
